title: When You Wish
style: Warm uplifting vocal jazz track, piano-led with rich acoustic or warm Rhodes piano, walking upright bass, soft brushed drums with gentle swing, subtle warm saxophone or muted trumpet fills and harmonies. Soulful, heartfelt lead vocal with rich tone and emotional delivery. Light background vocal harmonies and gentle ad-libs. Uplifting hopeful lyrics about the power of wishing from the heart and wishes actually coming true. Magical yet grounded, positive, heart-opening energy. Intimate jazz club feel with modern production clarity and warmth. Light playful scat in the bridge. 92 BPM, warm major key, cinematic but cozy and sincere.
lyrics:
Full Lyrics
[Intro – soft piano, warm vocal]
Mmm… close your eyes now…
Make that wish… let it fly…
[Verse 1]
In the hush between the heartbeats, when the world slows down its spin
You send a little whisper out and wonder if it’s sinking in
But the stars are always listening, and the moon keeps every score
Every wish you make with feeling finds its way back to your door
[Chorus]
I wish that when you wish, your wishes come true
All the beautiful things you’re dreaming of, coming home to you
From the deepest part of hoping to the highest point of light
When you wish it with your whole heart, it can happen overnight
I wish that when you wish… your wishes come true
[Verse 2]
Doesn’t matter if it’s simple, like a smile on a cloudy day
Or the biggest dream you’re carrying that just won’t fade away
Plant it in the soil of belief, give it water made of faith
Watch the universe conspire in the most mysterious ways
[Chorus]
I wish that when you wish, your wishes come true
All the beautiful things you’re dreaming of, coming home to you
From the deepest part of hoping to the highest point of light
When you wish it with your whole heart, it can happen overnight
I wish that when you wish… your wishes come true
[Bridge – building, light scat]
Oh I wish… I wish…
For every wish you make…
May it bloom… may it grow…
May it find you… don’t you know…
Jazz scat ad-lib:
Doo bee doo… wah wah… come true… yeah…
Mmm… I wish it for you…
[Final Chorus – full band, warm swell]
I wish that when you wish, your wishes come true
Every single one of them is waiting just for you
Big or small, near or far
When you wish it from the heart… it can be yours
I wish that when you wish… your wishes come true…
[Outro – gentle piano + fading vocal]
Close your eyes now… make that wish…
Your wishes come true…
